description: Star a wiki page for yourself — your favourites, nobody else sees them: the page is listed under «Starred» above its space's page tree, in list_starred_wiki_pages, and first in the app's quick switcher. Starring needs only to be able to read the page. A page already starred stays so. The same star is the personal label my:favourite and CQL favourite = currentUser() on the compatible API.

id.description: Page id (as search_wiki or get_wiki_page give it).

name: star_wiki_page
title: Star wiki page
